a monthly salary: Instead of being paid every week, she receives a monthly salary that arrives on the first day of each month.
她不是每週領薪水，而是領月薪，每個月的第一天入帳。
monthly installments: We could not pay for the car at once, so we pay for it in twelve monthly installments over one year.
我們無法一次付清車款，所以在一年內分十二期每月分期付款。
a monthly magazine: My uncle subscribes to a monthly magazine about cars, and a new issue arrives in his mailbox every month.
我叔叔訂閱了一本汽車月刊，每個月都有新的一期寄到他的信箱。
moral support: My friends could not help me study, but they came to the exam hall to give me moral support.
我的朋友無法幫我讀書，但他們來到考場給我精神上的支持。
the moral high ground: By apologizing first after our fight, my sister took the moral high ground and made me look childish.
吵架後我姊姊先道歉，站上了道德高地，讓我顯得很幼稚。
a moral obligation: Even though no law requires it, many people feel they have a moral obligation to help strangers in danger.
雖然沒有法律規定，但許多人覺得自己有幫助陷入危險的陌生人的道義責任。
moral values: Parents play an important role in teaching children moral values such as honesty, kindness, and respect for others.
父母在教導孩子誠實、善良和尊重他人等道德價值上扮演重要角色。
the moral of the story: The moral of the story "The Tortoise and the Hare" is that slow and steady effort can win the race.
《龜兔賽跑》這個故事的寓意是：緩慢而穩定的努力也能贏得比賽。
a moral victory: Our team lost to the champions by only one point, but we still considered the game a moral victory.
我們隊只以一分之差輸給冠軍隊，但我們仍把這場比賽視為精神上的勝利。
moral courage: It takes moral courage to tell the teacher the truth when all your classmates are cheating on the test.
當全班同學都在考試作弊時，要向老師說出真相需要道德勇氣。
mountainous waves: During the typhoon, mountainous waves crashed against the harbor, and all fishing boats were ordered to stay in port.
颱風期間，排山倒海的巨浪拍打著港口，所有漁船都被命令留在港內。
a mountainous task: Cleaning up the whole village after the flood was a mountainous task that took volunteers several months.
水災後清理整個村莊是一項艱鉅的任務，花了志工們好幾個月的時間。
mountainous regions: Many farmers in the mountainous regions of Taiwan grow tea because the cool, high land is perfect for it.
台灣山區的許多農民種植茶葉，因為涼爽的高地非常適合種茶。
muddy the waters: Please stick to the facts; spreading rumors will only muddy the waters and make the problem harder to solve.
請只講事實；散播謠言只會把事情搞混，讓問題更難解決。
muddy thinking: The teacher said my essay showed muddy thinking because my ideas were unclear and poorly organized.
老師說我的作文顯示出混亂的思路，因為我的想法不清楚且組織不良。
a muddy color: The artist mixed too many paints together, and the sky in her picture turned a dull, muddy color.
那位畫家把太多顏料混在一起，她畫中的天空變成了暗沉、混濁的顏色。
muddy waters: After the heavy rain, the river was full of muddy waters, so we could not see any fish swimming in it.
大雨過後，河裡都是混濁的水，所以我們看不到任何魚在裡面游。
multiple choice: The English test has two parts: forty multiple choice questions and one short essay.
這次英文考試有兩個部分：四十題選擇題和一篇短文寫作。
multiple injuries: The driver suffered multiple injuries, including a broken arm and several cuts, and was rushed to the hospital.
那名駕駛多處受傷，包括手臂骨折和好幾處割傷，並被緊急送往醫院。
multiple copies: Before the meeting, please make multiple copies of the report so that every member can have one.
開會前，請把報告印成多份複本，讓每位成員都能拿到一份。
on multiple occasions: I have reminded him on multiple occasions to lock the door, but he still forgets almost every day.
我已經多次提醒他鎖門，但他還是幾乎每天都忘記。
multiple personality: In the movie, the main character has a multiple personality and acts like several completely different people.
在這部電影中，主角有多重人格，表現得像好幾個完全不同的人。
the municipal government: The municipal government of Taipei plans to build more bike lanes to reduce traffic in the city.
台北市政府計畫興建更多自行車道，以減少市區的交通量。
municipal elections: Citizens will vote for a new mayor and city council members in the municipal elections next month.
市民將在下個月的市級選舉中投票選出新市長和市議員。
municipal services: Municipal services such as garbage collection and street cleaning are paid for by the city's taxes.
垃圾收集和街道清掃等市政服務是由城市的稅收支付的。
muscular strength: Lifting weights three times a week can improve your muscular strength and help protect your bones.
每週舉重三次可以增強你的肌力，並幫助保護你的骨骼。
a muscular build: Years of weightlifting have given him a muscular build with big arms and a wide chest.
多年的舉重訓練讓他擁有肌肉發達的體格，手臂粗壯、胸膛寬闊。
muscular Christianity: In the nineteenth century, muscular Christianity taught that sports and physical strength could build good moral character.
在十九世紀，強健派基督教主張運動和體能可以培養良好的品德。
